Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Chino Hills for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 5 (the city's Holiday Tree Lighting at City Hall) through December 19 (Breakfast with Santa), with the 34th Annual Chino Hills Boat Parade (December 11) along the way, plus the library's Holiday Scavenger Hunt and Winter Luau and the It Was Christmas Advent Concert with Bill Drake. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Chino Hills

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Chino Hills
  • 2 free events: the Holiday Tree Lighting (December 5) and the Boat Parade (December 11)
  • Meet Santa: the Holiday Tree Lighting (December 5) and Breakfast with Santa (December 19)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Holiday Tree Lighting at City Hall (December 5, ceremony at 6:15 pm, with snow) and the 34th Annual Boat Parade (December 11, 7 pm)
  • Trains: no holiday train ride in Chino Hills (see our California Christmas train rides guide)
  • Season: December 5 to December 19 (the three live cards have their own dates)

Planning a bigger day out? Chino Hills families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Rancho Cucamonga, which covers Victoria Gardens Santa Photos and light shows, Snow Much Fun Day and The Nutcracker.
